## Current Code Workflow (from code analyzer)
# Model Overview (for Diagnosis)

Diagnosis targets a masked BERT4Rec model through ModelView. Relevant hooks are `item_emb`, `log2feats(sequence)`, and `predict_score(features, items)`; backbone internals are not supplied. For user geometry, training histories are truncated, left-padded, and appended with the reserved MASK token. The user representation is the feature at the maximum nonpadding index—the appended MASK position.

# Diagnosis Inputs & Hooks

`DiagnosisProbe(view, device)` stores the view, its actual module (`view.model`), histories, and metadata references. It discovers `sample_batch` from the module’s defining Python module to access corruption bookkeeping.

The loader supplies `(None, sequence, positive, negative)` with matching B × L shapes. The probe validates token ranges, obtains per-position features, and requests B × L × 2 positive/negative logits. Geometry and margin probes use evaluation mode and restore the previous mode.

# Probes & Metrics

- **Embedding directional alignment:** Samples up to 2,048 real-item embeddings, excluding padding/MASK, and maps mean pairwise cosine to [0,1]. Higher values indicate stronger alignment; this alone does not establish collapse or poor recommendation diversity.
- **Representation geometry:** Samples up to 256 real items and 256 users. Reports mean raw L2 norm, centered variance, centered singular values, and RankMe (entropy-based effective rank). Low variance or effective rank can suggest restricted representations; no universal health threshold is defined.
- **Positive–negative margins:** Across up to ten batches, computes positive minus negative logits at valid supervised positions. Larger mean and 10th-percentile margins indicate clearer separation; lower negative-wins and small-margin rates are preferable. Small margins use ε = 0.5.
- **Coverage:** Counts supervised input types, empty batches, and corruption branches only when sampler bookkeeping exactly matches the batch.

# Perturbation & Tests

The probe does not create additional corruption or sensitivity comparisons. It examines loader-provided MASK/random/unchanged inputs and constructs appended-MASK histories for inference-like geometry. Observed same-item inputs cannot independently identify their corruption branch.

# MODEL_DIAGNOSIS Schema & Limitations

`run_full_diagnosis` returns `metrics` and `metric_definitions`, covering alignment, geometry, four margin summaries, and breakdown/coverage details. Unavailable measurements are null; category lists remain empty because categories are unavailable.

`diagnosis_interpreter_prompt` embeds both sections and requests JSON with `status`, `core_findings`, `key_implications`, and `evidence`; it does not itself generate an interpretation. ## Current Code Workflow (from code analyzer)
# Model Overview (for Diagnosis)

Diagnosis targets a masked BERT4Rec model through ModelView. Relevant hooks are `item_emb`, `log2feats(sequence)`, and `predict_score(features, items)`; backbone internals are not supplied. For user geometry, training histories are truncated, left-padded, and appended with the reserved MASK token. The user representation is the feature at the maximum nonpadding index—the appended MASK position.

# Diagnosis Inputs & Hooks

`DiagnosisProbe(view, device)` stores the view, its actual module (`view.model`), histories, and metadata references. It discovers `sample_batch` from the module’s defining Python module to access corruption bookkeeping.

The loader supplies `(None, sequence, positive, negative)` with matching B × L shapes. The probe validates token ranges, obtains per-position features, and requests B × L × 2 positive/negative logits. Geometry and margin probes use evaluation mode and restore the previous mode.

# Probes & Metrics

- **Embedding directional alignment:** Samples up to 2,048 real-item embeddings, excluding padding/MASK, and maps mean pairwise cosine to [0,1]. Higher values indicate stronger alignment; this alone does not establish collapse or poor recommendation diversity.
- **Representation geometry:** Samples up to 256 real items and 256 users. Reports mean raw L2 norm, centered variance, centered singular values, and RankMe (entropy-based effective rank). Low variance or effective rank can suggest restricted representations; no universal health threshold is defined.
- **Positive–negative margins:** Across up to ten batches, computes positive minus negative logits at valid supervised positions. Larger mean and 10th-percentile margins indicate clearer separation; lower negative-wins and small-margin rates are preferable. Small margins use ε = 0.5.
- **Coverage:** Counts supervised input types, empty batches, and corruption branches only when sampler bookkeeping exactly matches the batch.

# Perturbation & Tests

The probe does not create additional corruption or sensitivity comparisons. It examines loader-provided MASK/random/unchanged inputs and constructs appended-MASK histories for inference-like geometry. Observed same-item inputs cannot independently identify their corruption branch.

# MODEL_DIAGNOSIS Schema & Limitations

`run_full_diagnosis` returns `metrics` and `metric_definitions`, covering alignment, geometry, four margin summaries, and breakdown/coverage details. Unavailable measurements are null; category lists remain empty because categories are unavailable.

`diagnosis_interpreter_prompt` embeds both sections and requests JSON with `status`, `core_findings`, `key_implications`, and `evidence`; it does not itself generate an interpretation. These sampled training probes do not measure validation HR@10, full-catalog ranking, causal sensitivity, or simulator traits.
